mentions.name: Recurve
mentions.description: A web-based multiplayer "curve-like" game inspired by Curve Fever 2, recreating the elegance of the original gameplay while adding optional features such as portals, rocket launchers, custom maps, and capture-the-flag mode, aiming for the hilarity and semi-competitiveness of Halo 3 custom games. Technical work includes server and browser performance, mapping 2D game space onto a 3D visual space, and a dynamic music system.
mentions.problem: The original Curve Fever 2 is gone, and the game that took its place has objectionable aesthetic and gameplay tweaks.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've been working on making my dream "curve-like" game that captures the elegance of the original's gameplay while also allowing optional stuff like portals, rocket launchers, custom maps and modes like capture-the-flag. I'm kind of going for that sense of hilarity and semi-competitiveness of e.g. Halo 3 custom maps and modes.

https://recurvegame.com
